title: Elisha Prophesies Plenty

questions.question: What did Elisha prophesy about the famine in Samaria?
options: Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour shall be sold for a shekel
questions.correctAnswer: Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour shall be sold for a shekel
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:1 (ESV): "...Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour shall be sold for a shekel..."

questions.question: Who doubted Elisha's prophecy?
options: The captain on whose hand the king leaned
questions.correctAnswer: The captain on whose hand the king leaned
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:2 (ESV): "Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned said to the man of God, 'If the LORD himself should make windows in heaven, could this thing be?'"

questions.question: Who discovered that the Syrian camp was empty?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:3 (ESV): "Now there were four men who were lepers... And they went into the camp..."

questions.question: Why did the Syrians flee?
options: The Lord made them hear the sound of chariots and horses, the sound of a great army
They were afraid of the lepers
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord made them hear the sound of chariots and horses, the sound of a great army
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:6 (ESV): "For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians hear the sound of chariots and of horses, the sound of a great army..."

questions.question: What happened to the captain who doubted?
options: The people trampled him in the gate and he died
questions.correctAnswer: The people trampled him in the gate and he died
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:17 (ESV): "...and the people trampled him in the gate, so that he died, as the man of God had said..."

questions.question: Where were the four lepers sitting?
options: At the entrance of the gate
questions.correctAnswer: At the entrance of the gate
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:3 (ESV): "...at the entrance of the gate..."

questions.question: What did the lepers say to each other after eating and drinking?
options: We are not doing right. This day is a day of good news.
questions.correctAnswer: We are not doing right. This day is a day of good news.
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:9 (ESV): "Then they said to one another, 'We are not doing right. This day is a day of good news. If we are silent... punishment will overtake us.'"

questions.question: What did the King of Israel think when he heard the Syrians left?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:12 (ESV): "...I will tell you what the Syrians have done to us... They have gone out of the camp to hide... saying, 'When they come out... we shall take them alive...'"

questions.question: How did they verify the Syrian retreat?
options: Sent two chariots with horses to see
questions.correctAnswer: Sent two chariots with horses to see
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:14 (ESV): "So they took two mounted men..."

questions.question: What did the people do in the Syrian camp?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:16 (ESV): "Then the people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians."

questions.question: What specifically was predicted to happen to the doubt captain?
options: You shall see it with your own eyes, but you shall not eat of it
questions.correctAnswer: You shall see it with your own eyes, but you shall not eat of it
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:2 (ESV): "...You considered it impossible? Behold, you shall see it with your own eyes, but you shall not eat of it."

questions.question: Who did the Syrians think Israel had hired against them?
options: The kings of the Hittites and the kings of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: The kings of the Hittites and the kings of Egypt
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:6 (ESV): "...Behold, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Egypt..."

questions.question: How far did the trail of garments and equipment go?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:15 (ESV): "And they went after them as far as the Jordan..."

questions.question: How many measures of barley were sold for a shekel?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:1 (ESV): "...and two seahs of barley for a shekel..."

questions.question: When did the lepers decide to go to the king's household?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 7:9 (ESV): "...let us go and tell the king's household." 7:10: "So they came..." Context implies night/early morning.

key_verse_text: But Elisha said, “Hear the word of the LORD: thus says the LORD, Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour shall be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, at the gate of Samaria.” (ESV)
